notes.title: Shaping The Future
notes.content:
First of all, I want to give a big thank you from myself for your continued support on Inertia, Inertia was my first solo project and one that was designed for the sole purpose of being a simple game that had a skill gap but was enjoyable to play for everyone.

Over the past year and a half, I have made various changes based directly on community feedback, in some cases making major changes to movement and/or adding entirely new mechanics. I have taken into account both positive and negative reviews and tried to make changes where I saw a benefit.

Recently I have been teasing with the idea of creating a new project which would be loosely based around the Inertia world, with that in mind I would love to hear any feedback from Inertia’s community to take into account.

[list]
    [*]What would you improve from Inertia?
    [*]Are there any features, mechanics, etc that you feel are out of place within Inertia, or you would like to see in a follow up?
    [*]Would you like to see more short levels, more longer levels and/or an open world?
    [*]Any specific game-modes you feel like Inertia missed out on?
[/list]

Thank you all for continuing to enjoy playing Inertia!

notes.title: Minor Update: v1.18 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.18 will be rolling out later today (18/04) and will include the following changes. Mostly made up of quality of life changes that I felt were necessary to the future of Inertia.

[h1]General improvements, implementations & fixes[/h1]

[b]Movement[/b]
[list]
    [*]Removed walking completely, runner now defaults to 650u/s without holding an input for sprint.
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
    [*]Removed 'Unify' from speedrun mode.
    [*]Updated Playground level to include wallrun decals.
    [*]Made slight material changes to a couple of levels.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added a difficulty rating to the level selection menu.
    [*]Added level art for speedrun levels.
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
    [*]Both speedrun levels should now be unlocked by default.
    [*]Both speedrun levels should now correctly upload leaderboard scores to the individual levels as well as to the master leaderboard upon completion of the level.
    [*]All levels are now unlocked by default. (it's worth noting that levels do get progressively harder so new players are still recommended to play from level #1.)
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or issues, feel free to report it here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/1/

Have feedback or suggestions? post them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/

notes.title: Major Update: v1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Additions[/h1]
[b]Introducing Speedrun Mode[/b]
[list]
    [*]Speedrun mode is a new game-mode for Inertia, where individual level timers are replaced with a global timer for each collection.
    [*]The global timer is paused upon loading and resetting levels does not reset the timer (Unless it's the first level of the collection).
    [*]The global timer is not paused when the game is paused.
    [*]This mode completely disables the 'Complete' UI and walking through EndVolumes will automatically trigger the next level to start.
[/list]


[h1]General improvements, implementations & fixes[/h1]
[b]Elements[/b]
[list]
    [*][b][i]Zipline[/i][/b]
    [list]
    	[*]Zipline now takes the player's velocity into account when calculating the speed of the zipline.
	[*]Zipline will now apply the correct velocity when letting go.
	[*]Zipline now sweeps collision to check if anything was hit, and will let go if it was.
	[*]Letting go of the zipline now applies previous velocity, meaning you fall like you should instead of falling straight down.
	[*]The consistency of letting go is now far higher than v1.03.
	[*]Moved Zipline achievement out of the main zipline thread, it shouldn't have been there in the first place.
	[*]Added a clamp for MaxExitSpeed of Zipline, at 1200u/s.
    [/list]

    [*][b][i]Collapsing Platform[/i][/b]
    [list]
    	[*]Default TimeUntilCollapse is now 0.3 seconds, down from 0.6 seconds.
        [*]Default ReactivateTime is now 0.6 seconds, down from 2.0 seconds.
    [/list]

    [*][b][i]Death Volume[/i][/b]
    [list]
    	[*]Contrary to the name, the death volume will now send players to the beginning of the level instead of killing them.
    [/list]
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
    [*]Soundtrack no longer resets when restarting the same level, though it will change when starting a new level.
[/list]

[b]Options/UI[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added Crosshair UI.
    [*]Added UI option - Show/Hide Crosshair.
[/list]

[b]Input[/b]
[list]
    [*]'Fast Restart' now sends player back to the beginning of the level instead of completely restarting.
    [*]Mouse is no longer locked to the viewport after tabbing out.
[/list]

[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
    [*]Level #23: Classics - Changed geometry of blocking walls.
    [*]Level #30: Classics - Fixed wallrunning on side walls.
    [*]Level #14: Classics - Added missing Wallrun pathing.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
    [*]Changed method of giving achievement for 'Like A Speed Demon'
    [*]Optimised stopwatch UIs.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or issues, feel free to report it here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/1/

Have feedback or suggestions? post them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/

notes.title: Major Update: v1.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update: v1.0 - 1st December 2017[/h1]

[h1]New Additions:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Introducing the Level Creator[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]In-game level creation.
	    [*]Full collection of obstacles with control over parameters.
	    [*]Able to save out maps.
	    [*]Test your new levels on the fly.
	    [*]Share your creations via Steam Workshop.
	[/list]

    [*][b]Introducing Steam Workshop Support[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Share levels created with the built-in level creator on the Steam Workshop.
	    [*]Upload and update your workshop item in-game.
	    [*]Subscribe to levels created by the community and play them instantly.
	[/list]

    [*][b]Introducing the Unify Collection[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]The Unify Collection is the final collection before full-release.
	    [*]It stitches the 32 levels from the Classics collection together to form 6 indivdual longer running levels.
	    [*]Built with speed-running in mind.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]General improvements, implementations & fixes:[/h1]
[b]Steam[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added 8 achievements.
    [*]Update store page to reflect changes.
    [*]Updated achievement descriptions to fit around the Creator.
    [*]Opened up Steam Workshop to the public.
[/list]

[b]Character/Movement[/b]
[list]
    [*]Velocity cap removed completely.
    [*]Velocity now accurately carries through teleporters.
    [*]Added new character for level creation.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
    [*]New UI: Creator UI.
    [*]New UI: Steam Workshop UI.
    [*]New UI: Save/Load Level UI.
    [*]New UI: Elements UI.
    [*]New UI: Play Menu. (Official Levels/Community Levels)
    [*]Modified Frontend UI to fit Creator mode and new Play Menu UI.
[/list]

[b]Levels/Elements[/b]
[list]
    [*]Level #16 - Classics: Adjust structure slightly.
    [*]Level #24 - Classics: Fixed incorrect texture.
    [*]Collapsing platform no longer disappears when active.
[/list]

[b]Controller Support[/b]
[list]
    [*]Modified controller movement. (Sprint is now combined with walk by pushing the thumbstick forward rather than having to press and hold the thumbstick down)
    [*]Adjusted sensitivity options for controller.
    [*]Completely overhauled axis control, player's speed in X/Y direction is now dependent on how hard the thumbstick is being held in X/Y direction.
    [*]Added a new movement mode specifically targetting controller users. (Lower air control and gravity values)
    [*]Strafe Jumping is now completely disabled for controllers.
[/list]

Note: Since Inertia was published via Early Access on 15th September 2017, there have been some major updates to the game. Early Access saw the release of multiple new levels, major changes and implementations to the movement, new tutorial level(s) and more. notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.content:
It's almost been a full month since my last update on Inertia so I just wanted to post a quick update to let everyone know that development is still ongoing. The following is just a bit of information about the plans for the near future of Inertia as well as some information on full release.

[h1]Plans/Roadmap[/h1]
Continuing throughout November and possibly early December I'm going to be working on mod support/level creation/workshop support for Inertia and figuring out the best way to handle all of that, I'm also planning to start on a new level collection.

[h1]Full release[/h1]
The vision for full release is to include some form of level creation and steam workshop support for that, access to developer console as well as at least 50 levels included in the base game so there's a fair bit of work to do before it gets to a stage that I'm happy to push the game for full release. Localisation is hit-or-miss and may or may not be included, it's an expensive and complicated process.

Thanks to everyone for being patient over the past month!

notes.title: Major Update: v0.7 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update: v0.7 - 3rd October 2017[/h1]

[h1]Movement & Mechanics:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Strafe Jumping[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Players have to input forward movement, similar to Quake/CoD2/CoD4 strafe jumping. (Sprint keys + left/right keys + mouse movement)
	    [*]Unlike Inertia's bhopping mechanic, there is no strict limit on velocity.
	    [*][b]Not a core mechanic[/b], purpose is to increase the skill ceiling for speedrunners without affecting players who aren't worried about records.
	    [*]Can be enabled/disabled in 'Gameplay & UI' settings menu, it is enabled by default.
	    [*]Values may be tweaked over time to perfect the mechanics with help from player feedback.
	[/list]

    [*][b]Movement Modes[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Certain movement values adjusted to give the player less 'complete' control over velocity whilst in the air, as well as lessening the gravity scale slightly for balancing purposes.
	    [*]For anyone wishing to use the previous movement values, there is now an option in 'Gameplay & UI' allowing you to go back to the 'Legacy' movement mode which reverts the values to what they were at release and in v0.6.
	    [list]
	    [*]Air Control: New (Default): 0.65 - Old (Legacy): 1.0
	    [*]Gravity Scale: New (Default): 1.15 - Old (Legacy): 1.2
	    [*]Braking Deceleration: New (Default): 100 - Old (Legacy): 0
	    [*]Friction Factor: New (Default): 1 - Old (Legacy): 2
	    [/list]
	[/list]

    [*][b]Sliding[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Removed sliding 'impulse' speed, sliding now outputs a consistent speed of 1680u/s.
	    [*]Players are now able to slide immediately after a cancelled slide.
	    [*]Addressed an issue where slides weren't completely cancelled when the input was released.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Levels:[/h1]
[list]
    [*][b]Annex Collection[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Consisting of 10 brand new levels.
	    [*]Independent level progression, you do not have to complete the Classics before starting Annex.
	    [*]Introduces new obstacles and designs to the game.
	    [*]Similar in style to the Classics collection.
	[/list]
    [*][b]Classics Collection[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Level #10: Fixed some misplaced light beams.
	    [*]Level #20: Fixed some misplaced light beams.
	    [*]Level #23: Removed head blocking volume above the map.
	    [*]Level #28: Fixed a couple of incorrect materials.
	    [*]Level #32: Added a small ledge near wall-run.
	[/list]
    [*][b]Tutorial[/b]
	[list]
	    [*]Tutorial is now a sandbox playground rather than a linear level.
	[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Audio/Music:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added soundtrack which is randomised each time you spawn, depending on feedback this may change to each level having it's own track.
    [*]Added audio for flamethrower element.
[/list]

[h1]General improvements/Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]The game is now paused when the player fails the level and the retry UI is shown.
    [*]Tutorial/Playground level now appears at the front of the level select list.
    [*]Added Steam stats, leaderboards and achievements for the Annex Collection.
    [*]Achievement 'Like A Speed Demon' trigger point changed to improve consistency.
    [*]Achievement 'Born Ready' is now triggered when the playground level is opened.
    [*]All levels now have a collection tag for easier sorting.
    [*]Added Depth of Field graphics option.
    [*]Depth of Field and Bloom are now handled separately from the Post Processing graphics option.
    [*]Rearranged graphics options slightly.
    [*]Wallrunning should be a little less 'sticky' now.
    [*]Localisation preparations. (font changes, etc)
    [*]Fixed a positioning issue in Gameplay/UI options.
    [*]Leaderboard now shows the public level name rather than the internal level name.
    [*]Fixed bug where animation state would get stuck after cancelling a slide, preventing various events (footsteps, etc) from triggering successfully.
    [*]Friction values slightly adjusted, which should adhere to a more realistic friction drag equation, reducing the 'gliding' feeling.
    [*]Falling from the zipline should now set the player's movement state correctly.
    [*]Landing now resets the bhop timer completely, removing the (extremely small) chance of an incorrectly failed bhop.
    [*]Removed 'Engine Version' from Advanced UI.
    [*]Removed 'Game Version' from Advanced UI.
    [*]Separated 'Speed' and 'Time' from other information in Advanced UI.
    [*]Added Game Version to Frontend UI.
    [*]Fixed an issue with footsteps playing briefly after leaving the ground.
    [*]Renamed 'Reset' input to 'Restart Level'.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs or issues, feel free to report them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/1/

Have feedback or suggestions? post them here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/666330/discussions/

notes.title: The Annex Collection - Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]The Annex Collection - 3rd October 2017[/h1]

The Annex Collection is a new collection of 10 levels for Inertia, maintaining the style of the Classics Collection whilst adding new layouts and obstacles which will make reaching the end of each level that little bit harder.

Each new collection will have it's own level progression, which means that players do not have to complete the previous collection(s) to begin playing a new one.

The Annex Collection is planned for launch alongside a major update (v0.7) on the 3rd October 2017.
